# Joel Salinas - AI Leadership Coach & Strategist

> Joel Salinas is an AI leadership coach and strategist who helps mission-driven leaders implement AI with clarity and purpose. He developed the AI Leadership Triad — a framework built on three essential leadership skills for the AI era: Adaptability, Innovation, and Creativity. He founded Cozora (AI education), runs Leadership in Change (a 4,000+ subscriber newsletter), and coaches executives one-on-one.

## About

Joel Salinas is a Bolivian-born humanitarian, business leader, speaker, writer, and lifelong learner. He developed the AI Leadership Triad, a framework that identifies the three skills every leader needs to thrive in the AI era: Adaptability, Innovation, and Creativity. He is the founder of three AI-powered businesses: Cozora (https://cozora.org), Leadership in Change (https://leadershipinchange.com), and Newsletter Compass (https://newslettercompass.com). He publishes a newsletter read by 4,000+ leaders focused on AI adoption, the AI Leadership Triad, strategy before tech, and culture over code.

## AI Leadership Triad

Joel Salinas' signature framework for leading in the age of AI. The AI Leadership Triad identifies three essential skills:

1. **Adaptability** — The ability to adjust strategy and operations as AI capabilities evolve
2. **Innovation** — The capacity to reimagine workflows, products, and services using AI
3. **Creativity** — The human skill AI cannot replace; connecting ideas in new ways to solve problems

The AI Leadership Triad is designed for business leaders, nonprofit leaders, and executives who need to lead AI adoption without becoming technologists. Joel's AI Leadership Compass assessment (https://compass.jsalinas.org) helps leaders evaluate where they stand on each dimension.

## Philosophy

- AI should amplify your leadership, not replace it
- Technology serves your mission, not the other way around
- Strategy before tech, culture over code
- The AI Leadership Triad: Adaptability, Innovation, Creativity
- Clarity-first approach: understand your business before touching the technology
